title: Measuring Protein Levels in Planarians Using Western Blotting
author: Ziman, Oviedo

steps.title: Prepare 1× Running Buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 100 mL of 10× Running Buffer with 900 mL MilliQ water to make 1 L of 1× Running Buffer; store at 4 °C and prepare fresh each use.

steps.title: Prepare 10% APS
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.1 g ammonium persulfate (APS) in MilliQ water to a final volume of 1 mL (10% w/v); store at 4 °C and use within 7 days.

steps.title: Prepare 10% SDS Solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS) in MilliQ water to a final volume of 10 mL (10% w/v); store at 25 °C (stable for weeks‑months).

steps.title: Prepare 1.0 M Tris pH 6.8
steps.instruction: Dissolve 6.06 g Tris base in MilliQ water, adjust pH to 6.8, and bring the volume to 50 mL; store at 25 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 1.5 M Tris pH 8.8
steps.instruction: Dissolve 9.09 g Tris base in MilliQ water, adjust pH to 8.8, and bring the volume to 50 mL; store at 25 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Protease Inhibitor Cocktail
steps.instruction: Dissolve one protease inhibitor cocktail tablet in 1.5 mL MilliQ water; aliquot 150 µL, store at –20 °C (stable for weeks‑months).

steps.title: Prepare 100 mM PMSF
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.17 g phenylmethanesulfonyl fluoride (PMSF) in 10 mL isopropanol (100 mM); aliquot 1 mL, store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 100 mM DTT
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.154 g DL‑dithiothreitol (DTT) in 10 mL MilliQ water (100 mM); aliquot 0.5 mL, store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare BSA Standards
steps.instruction: Make bovine serum albumin (BSA) standards ranging from 0 to 10 µg/µL (or purchase ready‑made standards).

steps.title: Acclimate Bradford Reagent
steps.instruction: Allow the Bradford Reagent to reach 25 °C before use.

steps.title: Gather Protein Extraction Tools
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: (a) pellet pestle cordless motor, (b) RNase‑free disposable pellet pestles (one per sample), (c) 1.5 mL centrifuge tubes (two per sample), (d) 0.2 mL PCR tubes (three per sample), (e) MilliQ water, (f) 96‑well flat‑bottom plate, (g) multichannel p300 pipette, (h) multichannel disposable solutions basin, (i) refrigerated centrifuge (e.g., model 5430R) set to 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 6× Laemmli Buffer
steps.instruction: Make 25 mL of 6× Laemmli buffer according to the Materials and Equipment recipe; store at –20 °C in 500 µL aliquots.

steps.title: Prepare 1× Transfer Buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 100 mL 10× Transfer Buffer, 100 mL 100 % methanol, and 800 mL MilliQ water to make 1 L of 1× Transfer Buffer; store at 4 °C and prepare fresh.

steps.title: Prepare 1× PBS
steps.instruction: Mix 100 mL 10× PBS (pH 7.0) with 900 mL MilliQ water to obtain 1 L of 1× PBS; store at 25 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 1× TBST
steps.instruction: Make 1 L of 1× TBST according to the Materials and Equipment recipe; store at 25 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 1× TBST/SDS
steps.instruction: Make 250 mL of 1× TBST/SDS according to the Materials and Equipment recipe; store at 25 °C.

steps.title: Freeze Ice Pack
steps.instruction: Place the ice pack in a freezer so it is solid for the upcoming transfer step.

steps.title: Prepare 1× RIPA Buffer
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL tube on ice, combine MilliQ water, 10× RIPA buffer, 100 mM DTT, 100 mM PMSF (rock at room temperature or heat to 37 °C to dissolve), protease inhibitor cocktail, and optional phosphatase inhibitor cocktail; keep on ice. Adjust total volume according to the number of samples.

steps.title: Transfer Starving Planarians
steps.instruction: Using a transfer pipette, place 10–30 starving Schmidtea mediterranea animals into each labeled 1.5 mL centrifuge tube, leaving approximately 300 µL of water behind.

steps.title: Add RIPA Buffer to Samples
steps.instruction: Remove the remaining water quickly and add 150–200 µL of the prepared 1× RIPA buffer to each tube (for 8 mm animals use ~150–300 µL). Keep tubes on ice.

steps.title: Homogenize Samples
steps.instruction: Homogenize each sample on ice for ~10–20 s with a motorized pestle; use a new sterile pestle for each sample and discard after use.

steps.title: Incubate on Ice
steps.instruction: Incubate the homogenized samples on ice for 45 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge Extracts
steps.instruction: Spin the tubes in a pre‑cooled centrifuge at 20,817 × g for 20 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Collect Supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the supernatant from each tube to a clean, labeled 1.5 mL tube, avoiding disturbance of the pellet.

steps.title: Set Up Bradford Assay
steps.instruction: Perform a Bradford protein assay as follows:

substeps.instruction: Label 0.2 mL PCR tubes for triplicates of each sample (e.g., Sample 1A, 1B, 1C).
Add 95 µL MilliQ water to each tube.
Add 5 µL of the corresponding protein extract to each tube and vortex briefly; keep on ice.
Add 20 µL of each BSA standard (0–10 µg/µL) to wells of a 96‑well plate in triplicate.
Add 20 µL of each diluted sample (from the PCR tubes) to the plate in triplicate.
Using a multichannel pipette, add 200 µL of Bradford Reagent to every well.
Mix each well gently, avoiding air bubbles.

steps.title: Read Bradford Plate
steps.instruction: Measure absorbance at 595 nm with a plate reader; apply blank correction, fit a linear standard curve, and calculate %CV for each concentration.

steps.title: Export and Process Readings
steps.instruction: Export the plate reader data as an Excel file, average the triplicate values for each sample, and determine the volume of extract needed to obtain 50 µg total protein per sample.

steps.title: Normalize Sample Volumes
steps.instruction: For each sample:

substeps.instruction: Add the calculated volume of protein extract to achieve 50 µg total protein.
Add the same volume of 6× Laemmli buffer to every sample.
Add MilliQ water as needed to bring all samples to an identical final volume (aim for <20 µL loading volume).

steps.title: Export Blot Images
steps.instruction: Open the western blot images in Bio‑Rad Image Lab 6.0.1, then export each image as a 600 dpi TIFF file for publication.

steps.title: Quantify Bands in ImageJ
steps.instruction: Measure band intensities using ImageJ:

substeps.instruction: Draw a rectangle around a single band (no overlap).
Select the first band (Ctrl‑1 on PC or Cmd‑1 on Mac).
Drag the rectangle to the next band and press Ctrl‑2 (or Cmd‑2).
Repeat for all bands of interest.
Plot the selected lanes (Ctrl‑3 or Cmd‑3).
Add a straight line across the baseline of each peak.
Use the wand tool to click inside each peak and record the area under the curve.

steps.title: Normalize and Calculate Fold Change
steps.instruction: In Excel, record the anti‑caspase‑3 and anti‑actin intensities, divide anti‑caspase‑3 values by anti‑actin values for each lane, then divide each normalized sample value by the normalized control value to obtain fold‑change.
